name: lever one arm low row (plate loaded)
description: A one-arm version of the plate-loaded low row. Working one side at a time helps fix strength differences in your back.
instructions: Sit with your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Start with your arm extended and shoulder relaxed forward.
Pull the handle back, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
